visualCharacteristics.description: Linked image tiles with a title overlay and a description revealed on hover/focus, in a 1/2/3-column grid
visualCharacteristics.source: Six look-alike linked tiles (image, title overlay, hover description) in a wrapping 3-column grid, each linking to an industry detail page.

contentPattern.structure: Cell 1: image. Cell 2: H3 title, optional description paragraph, link to the detail page (makes the whole tile clickable)
rows: H3 title, description paragraph, link to industry page
one row per industry (6 rows; 'All Industries' has no description)

reuseGuidance: Use for image tiles linking to detail pages. A tile without an image (e.g. All Industries) is marked cards-industry-no-image for a solid-color treatment.
